title: eludite.editor.apply_code_action input
description: Apply an action of the light bulb menu (Enter on it, or a click): resolve it lazily with codeAction/resolve when it has no edit, then apply its WorkspaceEdit with the workspace-edit applier. Name it by `index` (from eludite.editor.code_actions) or by `title`. An action that is a command rather than an edit is reported `unsupported`: the pinned Roslyn's commands are client-side (nested actions and Fix All) and none goes through workspace/executeCommand. An action with nested actions opens them instead.

title.description: The action's title (the first match), instead of `index`.
